David Rowlands was reported missing by his family on October 31, 2025, and was last heard from on July 2, 2024. His last known location was a residence in New Westminster, British Columbia, but police have been unable to locate him in the Lower Mainland.
David's tendency to become disconnected from his family for extended periods was well-documented. A precedent has already established itself with him having previously resided in Mexico. Over the past five years, he has resided in New Westminster and Langley (BC), Calgary (AB), Halifax (NS), as well as in the UK and Mexico.

Alf flew to England on October 17, 1996 and was confirmed to have flown into Toronto airport on October 19, 1996, via British Airways. Alf has not been seen nor heard from since this date and his family and police are concerned for his safety and well-being.

All of the bodies of the remaining occupants were recovered with the exception of Allan Clemens and Tache Everett who were never located. Autopsies confirmed that the causes of death for those recovered were either drowning or death due to exposure in the cold water. Allan and Tache are presumed dead due to drowning.

Despite an intensive search by land, sea and air, the bodies of William and Thomas were never recovered.
